items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: Manuel Mineta would play with me on Biemble.

ctx.x: What was that? Is that the biggest one they had? The biggest one they had? Yeah. Number 7. Did all the musicians go to the same place?

Same place. Uh-huh. Is that Turo's or? Huh? Is that Turo? Or? No, Bassin and the man that ran there. Huh? The man that had that restaurant. He was on the Biscine. Oh yeah, on Bassin and, uh, Bassin and Aberville. Or Biemble. Or Biemble. I think Biemble. I forgot the name of the restaurant. I thought it was Turo. Did Manuel Mineta tell us about the restaurant? Yeah. Manuel Mineta would play with me on Biemble. Yeah. I was, I was, I was, we used to play ticket. How about transportation? How did you used to get back…
Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh.
